items.title: 20.2.1 Tools used in Recombinant DNA Technology (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the tools of recombinant DNA technology (PDF 156-157).

blocks.text: Gene of interest woh gene hai jis par kaam karna hai, yaani jise badalna ya doosre jandar mein dalna hai. Gene of interest in teen tareeqon mein se kisi aik se hasil kiya ja sakta hai:

items: Laboratory mein mukhtalif enzymes (maslan polymerases aur ligases) ki madad se gene of interest ko seedha bana lena (direct synthesis).
Us gene ke mRNA se reverse transcription kar ke gene banana; is ke liye reverse transcriptase enzymes istemal hote hain (yeh mRNA se DNA banate hain).
Restriction endonuclease enzymes se chromosome ko kaat kar gene alag kar lena (cleavage).

blocks.text: Yeh enzymes DNA mein nucleotides ke khaas silsilon (sequences) ko kaat'te hain, is liye inhein molecular scissors (molecular qainchi) bhi kehte hain. Restriction endonuclease ki bohat si qismein hain. Har qism DNA mein nucleotides ka aik khaas silsila pehchanti hai. Is silsile ko restriction site ya recognition region (pehchan ki jagah) kehte hain. Enzyme DNA ke saath isi silsile par jurta hai aur is site ke andar aik muqarrar jagah se DNA ko kaat deta hai.

blocks.alt: Lamba DNA duplex jis par do recognition sites hain: oopar wale strand par GAATTC aur neeche wale par CTTAAG. Teen-kone nishan har strand par G aur A ke darmiyan kataai dikhate hain. 'Action of enzyme' wala sabz teer teen tukron tak jata hai: darmiyani tukre ke dono siron par aik-strand wale AATT ubhaar hain aur kinare wale tukron par in se milte ubhaar.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.1: Restriction endonuclease ka amal (kitab ki Figure 20.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Recognition sites, DNA duplex, Restriction endonuclease, Action of enzyme, Single-stranded sticky ends (chipakne wale sire).

blocks.title: For information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Restriction endonucleases is liye qeemti hain ke aik hi restriction endonuclease se bane koi bhi do DNA tukre aapas mein jore ja sakte hain, kyun ke dono ke sticky ends aik doosre se milte hain.

Restriction sites mein chaar se aath nucleotides ke palindromic sequences hote hain. Palindromic ka matlab: restriction site ke aik sire ke nucleotides doosre sire ke nucleotides ke complementary (jor wale) hote hain. Is liye restriction site par DNA ke dono strands mein nucleotides ka aik hi silsila hota hai, bas ulti simton (opposite directions) mein chalta hai. Restriction endonuclease dono strands se jur kar dono ko kaat deta hai. Kaatne ke baad dono DNA tukron ke sire single-stranded (aik strand wale, chand nucleotides lambe) hote hain jo sticky (chipakne wale) hain, yaani aik doosre ke complementary hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Misal ke taur par EcoRI enzyme GAATTC silsila pehchanta hai. Neeche wale strand par ulti simt se parhein to bhi GAATTC hi hai; yahi palindrome hai. Enzyme G aur A ke darmiyan kaat'ta hai, is liye dono tukron par AATT ke chhote aik-strand wale sire bach jate hain jo aapas mein jur sakte hain.

Gene of interest ko host cells mein pohanchane ke liye khaas molecules istemal hote hain jinhein vectors (ya molecular carrier, yaani molecular sawari) kehte hain. Gene of interest vector ke saath jora jata hai aur vector recombinant DNA (rDNA) ban jata hai. Phir yeh rDNA host cells mein dala jata hai. Sab se zyada bacteria ke plasmids istemal hote hain. Doosre vectors yeh hain:

items: Bacteriophages (bacteria ke viruses), maslan phage lambda aur bacteriophage P1
Cosmids (aise plasmids jin mein bacteriophage DNA ka aik chhota hissa hota hai jise cos sequence kehte hain)
Bacterial artificial chromosomes – BACs (bacteria ke banawati chromosomes)
Yeast artificial chromosomes – YACs (yeast ke banawati chromosomes)
P1 artificial chromosomes (in mein P1 vectors aur Bacterial Artificial Chromosomes dono ki khoobiyan hoti hain)

blocks.text: Janwaron ke viruses (maslan insaan ke zukaam ka virus) bhi vectors ka kaam karte hain aur gene of interest ko bandar aur insaan ke cells mein le jate hain.

blocks.alt: Source DNA jis mein do kataai ki jagahon ke darmiyan gene of interest (gulabi) hai, restriction endonuclease se seedhi-darja (stepped) siron wale tukron mein kat'ta hai aur gene of interest alag ho jata hai. Gol vector (plasmid) usi enzyme se kat kar cleaved vector banta hai. Gene of interest cleaved vector mein jata hai aur dono jur kar recombinant DNA ka chhalla bante hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.2: Vector ka istemal (kitab ki Figure 20.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Restriction endonuclease, Gene of interest, Vector (Plasmid), Cleaved Vector, Recombinant DNA.

blocks.text: Yeh enzyme do DNA tukron ko jorta hai, is liye ise molecular glue (molecular gond) kehte hain. Yeh do saath saath wale (adjacent) nucleotides ke darmiyan phosphodiester linkage (bond) banata hai.

Expression system se muraad aisa munasib jandar hai jo rDNA (vector ke saath jura gene of interest) ka host ban sake aur gene of interest ko express kar sake, yaani us gene se protein bana sake. Munasib expression system ka intikhab is baat par hai ke rDNA banane ke liye kaun sa vector istemal hua. Bacterial cells behtareen expression system hain kyun ke un ki generation time (nayi nasl banne ka waqt) chhota hai aur un ka genetic system saada hai.

blocks.prompt: Gene of interest aur plasmid dono ko aik hi restriction enzyme se kyun kaata jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Taa ke dono par aik jaise, aapas mein milne wale (complementary) sticky ends banein. Yeh sire aapas mein jur jate hain aur phir DNA ligase phosphodiester bonds bana kar inhein pakka jor deta hai.

items: Gene of interest: lab mein seedha banaya jaye, mRNA se reverse transcription se banaya jaye, ya restriction endonuclease se chromosome se kaata jaye.
Restriction endonucleases (molecular scissors) 4 se 8 nucleotides ki palindromic sites pehchan kar kaat'te hain aur sticky ends chhorte hain.
Vectors (zyada tar plasmids; phages, cosmids, BACs, YACs, P1 chromosomes, animal viruses) gene ko host cell tak le jate hain.
DNA ligase (molecular glue) phosphodiester linkage banata hai; bacteria behtareen expression system hain.
